overview: A futuristic, AI-powered study planner with task scheduling, progress tracking, productivity insights, animated dashboards, and AI-generated quizzes after each completed task. Designed for students with smooth animations, vibrant gradients, and a fully responsive layout.
features: Task scheduling with subject, duration, and due date
Live study session timer with start/pause/complete
AI-powered quizzes generated after task completion
Animated productivity charts and progress tracking
Study streaks and daily goal progress ring
Fully responsive design for mobile and desktop
